items.title: Supreme Court petition seeks action against ‘Green Army’ over military-style uniforms
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 11 A writ petition has been filed at the Supreme Court seeking action against Green Army Nepal, an organisation involved in rescue and relief operations following the Rasuwa floods, for allegedly using uniforms, ranks and insignia resembling those of the Nepali Army. items.title: Sanjay Sah, rescued from Trishuli 3A tunnel, discharged
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 11 Sanjay Sah, who was trapped inside a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project for 10 days following the Rasuwa Bhotekoshi flood on August 26, has been discharged from the hospital. items.title: Prime Minister Shah to highlight Nepal’s outsized climate burden at UN
items.summary: Following devastating Bhotekoshi floods, Shah will press for financial support to help Nepal recover and build climate resilience.

items.title: Nepal estimates Rs2.34 billion to rebuild flood-hit education sector
items.summary: Eighteen schools were affected in Rasuwa, disrupting classes for more than 9,000 students after the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Nepal prepares Krishnabhir bypass as temporary fix remains uncertain
items.summary: Officials are upgrading a 12-km road along the opposite bank of the Trishuli river as the landslide-prone Krishnabhir section of the Prithvi Highway remains closed.

items.title: A helicopter finally reaches flood-isolated Tiru of Rasuwa, 15 days after the devastating deluge
items.summary: With all roads and bridges washed away by the catastrophic August 26 floods, the village has been effectively cut off from the outside world.

items.title: Rapid assessment puts Bhotekoshi recovery needs at Rs723 billion
items.summary: Three-quarters of the bill is tied to infrastructure, with hydropower, roads, homes, and essential services among the hardest hit.

items.title: Climate loss and damage fund moves to consider urgent support for Nepal
items.summary: FRLD co-chairs say they are working with the Board to respond to Kathmandu’s request following the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Germany provides €8 million in assistance to Nepal after Bhotekoshi floods
items.summary: The package includes emergency relief, humanitarian aid and development support for health, energy and disaster-resilient infrastructure.
